description: Supplier receipts and expense documents, including sums, tax handling, status, recurrence settings and the related supplier, cost centre and document relations.

status.description: Filter by voucher status. The filter is documented for 50=Draft, 100=Unpaid/Due, 1000=Paid; the read domain also contains 150=Transferred and 750=Partially paid.

descriptionLike.description: Substring filter on the voucher description (essentially the voucher number).

startDate.description: Lower bound on voucherDate. sevdesk declares this parameter as an integer (epoch seconds) while the documented example shows '01.01.2020'; the declared type is authored here and the encoding is an open research gap.

endDate.description: Upper bound on voucherDate. Same declared-integer / dd.mm.yyyy-example inconsistency as startDate.

contact[id].description: Filter by supplier contact id (send together with contact[objectName]).

id.description: sevdesk id of the voucher; numeric value serialized as a JSON string on the wire.

mapAll.description: Request-mapping artifact echoed back in the response model.

update.description: Last-modification timestamp (system-set). Usable as an incremental watermark once the encoding of the updateAfter filter parameter is verified.

supplierName.description: Free-text supplier name, used when no Contact relation is set.

description.description: Voucher description; essentially the voucher number, but not documented as unique.

document.description: Document relation for the attached receipt file ({id, objectName='Document'}).

status.description: 50=Draft, 100=Unpaid/Due, 150=Transferred, 750=Partially paid, 1000=Paid. Serialized as a JSON string on the wire. The response model's machine enum lists only 50/100/1000; the documented status table (used here) is the full read domain.

sumNet.description: Net sum; numeric value serialized as a JSON string on the wire.

sumTax.description: Tax sum; numeric value serialized as a JSON string on the wire.

sumGross.description: Gross sum; numeric value serialized as a JSON string on the wire.

sumNetAccounting.description: Net sum in the accounting currency; numeric value serialized as a JSON string on the wire.

sumTaxAccounting.description: Tax sum in the accounting currency; numeric value serialized as a JSON string on the wire.

sumGrossAccounting.description: Gross sum in the accounting currency; numeric value serialized as a JSON string on the wire.

sumDiscounts.description: Discount sum; numeric value serialized as a JSON string on the wire.

sumDiscountsForeignCurrency.description: Discount sum in the foreign currency; numeric value serialized as a JSON string on the wire.

paidAmount.description: Amount already paid on this voucher.

taxRule.description: TaxRule relation ({id, objectName='TaxRule'}); bookkeeping system version 2.0. The model's id enum is stale (the narrative documents further expense rules), so no closed domain is enforced on reads — ReceiptGuidance endpoints are the runtime source of valid combinations.

taxType.description: Bookkeeping system version 1.0 only; replaced by taxRule under 2.0.

costCentre.description: CostCentre relation ({id, objectName='CostCentre'}). The model carries no nullable flag; treated as nullable because a voucher need not be assigned a cost centre.

propertyForeignCurrencyDeadline.description: Deadline used for the foreign-currency exchange rate.

propertyExchangeRate.description: Exchange rate; numeric value serialized as a JSON string on the wire.

recurringInterval.description: Recurrence interval as an ISO-8601 duration. Documented values: P0Y0M1W, P0Y0M2W, P0Y1M0W, P0Y3M0W, P0Y6M0W, P1Y0M0W, P2Y0M0W, P3Y0M0W, P4Y0M0W, P5Y0M0W; the narrative additionally lists P0Y2M, so the model enum is incomplete and no closed domain is enforced on reads.

recurringNextVoucher.description: Date the next recurring voucher is generated.

recurringLastVoucher.description: Date the last recurring voucher was generated.

enshrined.description: Set only via PUT /Voucher/{voucherId}/enshrine (irreversible, requires status >= 100); null until then. The one Voucher temporal with a real offset-bearing wire sample (2024-04-08T00:00:00+02:00).

taxSet.description: TaxSet relation (bookkeeping system version 1.0; used when taxType='custom').

deliveryDate.description: Delivery date, or the start of the delivery period when deliveryDateUntil is set.

mapAll.description: sevdesk request-mapping flag; must be sent as true.

supplierName.description: Free-text supplier name, used when no Contact relation is set.

description.description: Voucher description; essentially the voucher number.

status.description: Under bookkeeping system version 2.0 a voucher can only be created with status 50 (draft) or 100 (unpaid); elevation happens through the bookAmount/enshrine action endpoints. No closed enum is declared because version 1.0 tenants accept a wider domain.

taxType.description: Bookkeeping system version 1.0 only; replaced by taxRule under 2.0.

taxRule.description: TaxRule relation (bookkeeping system version 2.0). Valid rule ids depend on the tenant and the booking context; the ReceiptGuidance endpoints are the runtime source of valid combinations, and OSS rules 18/19/20 are unsupported for vouchers.

propertyForeignCurrencyDeadline.description: Deadline used for the foreign-currency exchange rate.

propertyExchangeRate.description: Exchange rate. Declared numeric by the write model; the read model returns it as a JSON string.

recurringInterval.description: Recurrence interval as an ISO-8601 duration (e.g. P0Y0M1W, P0Y1M0W, P1Y0M0W). The documented value list is inconsistent between the model enum and the narrative, so no closed domain is enforced.

recurringNextVoucher.description: Date the next recurring voucher is generated.

recurringLastVoucher.description: Date the last recurring voucher was generated.

deliveryDate.description: Delivery date, or the start of the delivery period when deliveryDateUntil is set.

id.description: sevdesk id of the voucher to update. Sending id + objectName + mapAll to saveVoucher updates the existing voucher; omitting id creates one. Only DRAFT vouchers can be updated. Declared numeric by the write model; the read model returns it as a JSON string.

mapAll.description: sevdesk request-mapping flag; must be sent as true.

supplierName.description: Free-text supplier name, used when no Contact relation is set.

description.description: Voucher description; essentially the voucher number.

status.description: saveVoucher only updates DRAFT vouchers; status elevation happens through the bookAmount/enshrine action endpoints.

taxType.description: Bookkeeping system version 1.0 only; replaced by taxRule under 2.0.

propertyForeignCurrencyDeadline.description: Deadline used for the foreign-currency exchange rate.

propertyExchangeRate.description: Exchange rate. Declared numeric by the write model; the read model returns it as a JSON string.

recurringInterval.description: Recurrence interval as an ISO-8601 duration (e.g. P0Y0M1W, P0Y1M0W, P1Y0M0W).

recurringNextVoucher.description: Date the next recurring voucher is generated.

recurringLastVoucher.description: Date the last recurring voucher was generated.

deliveryDate.description: Delivery date, or the start of the delivery period when deliveryDateUntil is set.
